description: This file defines the class TooManyEvaluationsException, which is a custom exception extending MaxCountExceededException, indicating that the maximum number of evaluations has been exceeded in some computational context.

classes.name: TooManyEvaluationsException
classes.description: An exception thrown when the maximum number of evaluations is exceeded.

methods.name: TooManyEvaluationsException
methods.description: Constructor that sets the maximum evaluation count and adds a localized message to the context.
